name: English - Management and Shakespeare C1
description: This course will build on four Shakespeare plays (Macbeth, Richard II, Henry IV, and King Lear) to help students recognize and analyze various principles of management, become more sensitive to interpersonal issues, and understand language and concepts that have shaped the contemporary Anglo-Saxon world. It will focus on aspects of leadership vs management, the value of money, risk, conflict management, personal/cultural identity and, last but not least, the art of successful communication: "The power of the word to change the world."
prerequisites: Ability to begin work at the C1 level as evidenced by your score on the placement test at www.moodle.tum.de. (Please check current announcements as the exact percentages may vary each semester.)
